name: jarvis-face
description: A living galaxy face for Jarvis: wireframe orb, nebula sky and a star network that answers the AI's voice.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @deadwick/orb-engine && npm run build -w @deadwick/voice && npm run build -w @deadwick/orb-demo
scripts.test: npm run test -w @deadwick/orb-engine && npm run test -w @deadwick/voice
scripts.check: npm run lint:tokens && npm run typecheck && npm run test
